name: How do I choose the right laminate flooring for my home?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right laminate flooring for my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right laminate flooring involves considering several factors specific to your home and lifestyle. Evaluate the AC rating (Abrasion Class), which indicates durability—AC3 is suitable for residential use, while AC4-AC5 is better for high-traffic areas. Consider the thickness (typically 6-12mm), as thicker planks offer better stability and sound absorption. Style, color, and texture should complement your home's aesthetic. Also, think about the warranty and if a water-resistant option is necessary for certain rooms. Our team can help you select the best product for your needs and budget.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose laminate by considering its AC rating for durability, plank thickness for stability, and style to match your home. Also, evaluate warranty and water resistance needs.
